Assumptions and status

Source: vignettes/assumptions-status.Rmd
assumptions-status.Rmd

assumptions() returns choices recorded with a merchandising result. status_codes() describes calculation diagnoses. threads() queries or changes the worker count for compiled equations. Currency labels use United States dollars (USD) in the example.

Recorded settings 

## Select a shipped tree
tree <- example_trees %>%
  filter(tree == 5)
tree spcd species dbh ht model
5 202 Douglas-fir 20 100 F00FW2W202 
## Load the example specifications
specifications <- example_products(name = 'douglas_fir')
product lengths min_length max_length min_sed trim volume_unit
Large sawlog 32 NA NA 12 0.5 scribner
Medium sawlog 16 NA NA 10 0.5 scribner
Small sawlog 16 NA NA 6 0.5 scribner
Pulp 8 20 3 0.5 green_ton 
## Select logs from the tree
result <- merchandise(dbh = tree$dbh,
                      ht = tree$ht,
                      model = tree$model,
                      species = tree$species,
                      id = tree$tree,
                      products = specifications,
                      currency = 'USD',
                      status = TRUE)
## Extract the choices recorded with the result
recorded <- assumptions(x = result)
assumption species model value units source
species_model Douglas-fir F00FW2W202 NA NA caller_model
stump_height NA NA 1 imperial package_default
unit_system NA NA NA imperial call
utilization_top Douglas-fir NA 3 imperial product_chain_default

Records include equation mappings, defaults, units, and applicable species-property choices. They omit local model coefficients. Preserve fitted objects or coefficient records with results using local equations.

Calculation diagnoses 

## List the merchandising diagnoses
codes <- status_codes() %>%
  filter(source == 'merchandising')
code name category description source
400 no_entry_product product no product passes the static entry rules merchandising
401 defect_height_out_of_range defect a defect height is outside the physical tree merchandising
402 defect_interval_invalid defect a defect interval has invalid or reversed bounds merchandising
403 defect_percent_out_of_range defect a defect percentage is outside zero through 100 merchandising
404 model_unresolved model no taper equation could be resolved for the species merchandising
406 unknown_defect_effect defect the defect effect is not in the supported vocabulary merchandising
407 unknown_curvature_category defect a sweep or crook category is not in curvature_scale merchandising
408 missing_product_attribute product a product rule needs a tree attribute that was not supplied merchandising
409 utilization_top_invalid utilization the utilization-top request is invalid for this tree merchandising
410 no_feasible_log product the tree is valid but no product log is feasible merchandising
411 scale_input_unavailable scaling a requested product scale cannot be computed from available inputs merchandising
412 profile_adapter_failure provider the stem profile adapter failed for this tree merchandising
413 reconciliation_failure reconciliation the physical volume ledger did not reconcile merchandising 
## Count tree statuses in the result
checks <- result$trees %>%
  count(status)
status n
0 1

status = TRUE retains diagnoses and suppresses tree-status warnings. Structural input errors still stop the call. The no_feasible_log diagnosis denotes valid zero log volume. Other merchandising failures require review before reporting totals.

Calculation workers 

## Query the current worker count
threads()
#> [1] 1

## Calculate diameters with a temporary worker count
with_threads(n = 4,
             code = dib(dbh = example_trees$dbh,
                        ht = example_trees$ht,
                        h = 20,
                        model = example_trees$model))
#> [1]  8.56020 11.00230 12.19541 14.74339 15.63832 20.14008

with_threads() restores the previous count when the expression finishes. MERCHANDISER_THREADS sets the initial count when the package loads. Equations written in R execute in the main R process.
